title: TH17 cells contribute to uveitis and scleritis and are inhibited by IL-27/STAT1 in the retina. \(5) Chromatin immunoprecipitation
protocol: Crosslink protein/DNA by adding 54 μl of 37% formaldehyde to 2 ml of media.
Shake gently to mix and then incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Add 200 μl of 10X Glycine solution to quench unreacted formaldehyde.
Mix gently and incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Remove medium and wash with cold PBS (2X).
Add 0.1 ml of PBS containing protease inhibitor cocktail.
Collect cells, centrifuge at 700xg for 3 min at 4°C and discard supernatant.
Resuspend cell pellet in 200 μl lysis buffer containing protease inhibitor cocktail.
Sonicate cell lysate on ice for 4 seconds three times.
Centrifuge at 14,000 rpm at 4°C for 10 min and transfer supernatant (~100 μl) to fresh tube.
Add 900 μl of dilution buffer containing protease inhibitor cocktail.
Add 60 μl of protein G agarose and incubate for 1 hour at 4°C with rotation.
Centrifuge at 3000g for 1 min and collect supernatant into fresh tube.
Add 4 μg of anti-STAT1 antibody and incubate overnight at 4°C with rotation.
Add 60 μl of protein G agarose for 1 hour at 4°C with rotation.
Centrifuge at 3000X g for 1 min and remove supernatant.
Wash pellet with low salt wash buffer, high salt wash buffer, LiCl immune complex wash buffer, and finally TE buffer.
Add 100 μl of elution buffer and mix gently.
Incubate at room temperature for 15 minutes.
Centrifuge at 3000 x g for 1 min and collect supernatant into new tube.
Repeat step of centrifuging at 3000 x g for 1 min and collecting supernatant into new tube.
Combine all collected supernatants from previous steps.
Add 8 μl of 5M NaCl to combined supernatant and incubate at 65°C for 5 hours.
Add 1 μl of RNase A to the mixture and incubate at 37°C for 30 minutes.
Add 4 μl of 0.5M EDTA, 8 μl of 1M Tris-HCl, and 1 μl of Proteinase K to the mixture and incubate at 45°C for 2 hours.
Add 1 ml of bind reagent A to each tube and mix well.
Transfer 600 μl of the mixture to a spin filter in a collection tube and centrifuge at 14,000 g for 30 seconds.
Discard liquid from the collection tube and place the spin filter back into it.
Transfer remaining 600 μl of mixture to the spin filter and centrifuge at 14,000 g for 30 seconds.
Remove liquid in the collection tube and add 500 μl of wash reagent B to the spin filter in the collection tube.
Place the spin filter into a new collection tube and add 50 μl of elution buffer to the spin filter.
Centrifuge at 14,000 x g for 30 seconds and save the eluate for PCR.
